title: Sanchin Dachi
body:
Syntax: sanchin dachi

Description: A stance granting +4 damage roll. Only one stance can be active; switch or leave it outside combat. Using the current stance again ends it. The stance persists through reconnects. Taijutsu unlocks at level 30. Costs 0 Chakra and 14 Stamina; 0 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
